adapters.discrete: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 Ti, Vulkan, USB4 enclosure

method: matte alone: tools/benchmark_roto_matte.py (roto.rasterise on resolved shapes, both drawers interleaved, 7 drawings per pass, 3 passes). Comp rows: tools/benchmark_gpu2d.py playback --no-sampler (48 frames, first lap, uncached, 1080p) driven one pass per call, rows interleaved legacy/fast, three rounds, NODEBASED_ROTO_DRAWER=legacy|fast; every pass took /tmp/nb-gpu.lock and ran with no integrator suite (load-log-1027e.txt, other_suites=0); the stand-in is taskset -c 0-3 with QT_SCALE_FACTOR=2; Automatic opens the island as the app does, the measurement kept in a file (NODEBASED_ISLAND_PROBE_FILE); the RTX row names the discrete card (--island-adapter default). Stage rows add --stages. Lock check: tools/benchmark_roto_matte.py --lock-check.
